verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents AI screening and matching: Talent Matching (part of Real Talent) analyzes and filters applications into tiers based on risk and relevance, and Voice AI runs structured top-of-funnel screening interviews. The Talent Matching description appears on a dedicated bias-audit-statement page, which suggests safeguards documentation exists. However, the excerpts don't show how matching works or which safeguards, human-review controls or audit results apply to automated decisions. Missing for 10: documented explanation of the matching methodology, concrete safeguards and human-oversight details for automated decisions, bias audit findings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
